'''Nathan Stahley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Montana State Championship]] on 15 April 2000 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|Docking Bay ISB]], according to Jeremy LaMere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d542">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-bozeman-mt-4-15-2000-statesd542/ bozeman-mt-4-15-2000-states], DeckTech (Jeremy "jerome" LaMere, 16 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-16-bozeman-mt-4-15-2000-statesd542/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
